description: Hypothesis: storing target and DFlash KV in FP16 and consuming half KV directly in device attention avoids the 32K Metal memory failure seen in the tuned-prefill base. Use --tuned-prefill with the same draft, prefix caching, batch sizes, projection kernels and FP32 accumulation/softmax/recurrent state. The evaluator revision and inherited performance thresholds are unchanged. Measure all seven tests with the full profile; FP16 rounding may change generated tokens and speculative acceptance.
